cards.text:
净化者忏悔士 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 5+ 10
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
责罪之槌 4 3+ 5/5 残暴、震荡
队列之首：在第一个转折点后的每个转折点中，每当这名特工为一名演说家并在激活中执行了冲锋，后撤
或转移行动，您便可以在其进行移动前使用本规则。若此，请确定受到布道增益的且对该特工可见的（反
之亦然)每一名其他己方净化者特工。在这名特工结束那个行动后，这些己方净化者特工的每一名都可
以按您希望的顺序立即执行一次无消耗的冲锋，后撤或转移行动（为每一名特工分别进行选择），但这些
特工不能移动超过 3" 或者被移除后再次部署到距离原先 3" 外的位置，并且在结束那个移动时必须依然位
于受到布道增益的范围内。如果这名特工在这个规则完整结算前被残废，如被戒备行动打断（见核心规则
书，近距离战斗），则在这个规则被结算前不要将其从杀戮区移除。
请继续阅读背面规则
净化者、帝国、国教教会、忏悔士 32
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SANCTIFIER CONFESSOR
2 6" 5+ 10
NAME A HIT D WR
Mace of Censure 4 3+ 5/5 Brutal, Shock
Lead the Procession: In each turning point after the first, whenever this operative is an ORATOR and performs the Charge, Fall
Back or Reposition action during its activation, you can use this rule before it moves. If you do, determine each other friendly
SANCTIFIER operative that’s benefitting from the SERMON and is visible to this operative (or vice versa). After this operative
ends that action, each of those friendly SANCTIFIER operatives can immediately perform a free Charge, Fall Back or
Reposition action in an order of your choice (choose separately for each), but each cannot move more than or be removed and
set up more than 3" and must end that move in a location where they are still benefitting from the SERMON. If this operative is
incapacitated before this rule is fully resolved, e.g. from the Guard action’s interruption (see close quarters rules, Kill Team Core
Book), don’t remove it from the killzone until this rule has been resolved.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
SANCTIFIER , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS MINISTORUM, LEADER, CONFESSOR 32

cards.image: 01-02-特工能力-净化者忏悔士-能力卡.png
cards.text:
净化者忏悔士 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 5+ 10
激昂宣令：每当位于这名特工 6" 内且可见的一名敌
方特工在激活或反击中执行一个行动时，您可以使
用本规则。若此，掷一枚 D6：若掷骰结果高于那
个敌方特工的 APL 属性：
• 它无法在那次激活或反击中执行那次行动（并且
消耗的 AP 不会退还）。若这是一次反应，则那
个反应结束。
• 您在战斗中不能再次使用本规则。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SANCTIFIER CONFESSOR
2 6" 5+ 10
Commanding Declamation: Whenever an enemy operative
would perform an action during an activation or counteraction
while visible to and within 6" of this operative, you can use this
rule. If you do, roll one D6: if the result is higher than that enemy
operative’s APL stat:
• It cannot perform that action during that activation/
counteraction (the AP spent on it isn’t refunded). If it’s a
counteraction, that counteraction ends.
• You cannot use this rule again during the battle.

cards.text:
净化者智天使 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 7" 5+ 5
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
激励器 3 5+ 1/3 震荡
智天使：
• 在判断对目标标识的控制时，将该特工的 APL 视
作比实际属性低 1 点。请注意，这并非对 APL 属
性的修正，因此任何修正将与本规则效果叠加。
• 当这名特工拥有隐匿命令且被掩护时，其无法被
选为有效目标，本规则优先于其他所有规则（例
如“追踪”武器规则和地形制高点），除非选择
目标的特工位于该特工的 2" 内。
• 这名特工无法使用任何不在其数据卡上的武器或
执行除了激励以外的任何独特行动。
请继续阅读背面规则
净化者、帝国、国教教会、智天使 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SANCTIFIER CHERUB
2 7" 5+ 5
NAME A HIT D WR
Incentiviser 3 5+ 1/3 Shock
Cherub:
• Whenever determining control of an objective marker, treat
this operative’s APL stat as 1 lower. Note this isn’t a change
to its APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.
• Whenever this operative has a Conceal order and is in cover,
it cannot be selected as a valid target, taking precedence
over all other rules (e.g. Seek, Vantage terrain) except being
within 2".
• This operative cannot use any weapons that aren’t on its
datacard, or perform unique actions other than Incentivise.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
SANCTIFIER , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS MINISTORUM, CHERUB 25

cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
净化者智天使
2 7" 5+ 5
飞行：每当这名特工开始执行冲锋，后撤或转移行
动时，便可以飞行。若选择飞行，不要移动它。作
为替代，将特工移出杀戮区，随后将其部署至完全
位于原本位置一定距离内，距离等同于该特工的移
动属性，并且在测量这个距离时，仅测量水平距离
（如果是墓穴世界这类使用近距离战斗规则的杀戮
区，您还不能越过或穿过墙壁地形测量距离）。请
注意，通过这种方式执行冲锋行动的特工不会获得
额外的移动距离。特工必须被部署至可以将其容纳
的位置，并且除了执行冲锋行动外，特工不能被部
署至敌方特工的交战范围内。
激励 1AP
支援。选择对这名特工可见且位于其 2" 内的另一
名己方净化者特工（忏悔士，死亡教派刺客，
圣迹士以及演说家除外）。直到那名特工下一次
激活结束前，为其 APL 属性增加 1 点。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此行
动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SANCTIFIER CHERUB
2 7" 5+ 5
Fly: Whenever this operative is performing the Charge, Fall
Back or Reposition action, it can FLY. If it does, don’t move
it. Instead, remove it from the killzone and set it back up wholly
within a distance equal to its Move stat horizontally of its original
location (in a killzone that uses the close quarters rules, e.g.
Killzone: Tomb World, this distance cannot be measured over or
through Wall terrain). Note that it gains no additional distance
when performing the Charge action. It must be set up in a
location it can be placed, and unless it’s the Charge action, it
cannot be set up within control range of an enemy operative.
INCENTIVISE 1AP
SUPPORT. Select one other friendly SANCTIFIER
operative (excluding CONFESSOR, DEATH CULT
ASSASSIN, MIRACULIST and ORATOR) visible to and
within 2" of this operative. Until the end of that operative’s
next activation, add 1 to its APL stat.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

opponent to have spent more AP than its APL stat – this is
permitted in this situation.

cards.text:
净化者圣迹士 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 4+ 7
1萦绕：这名特工可以在一名敌方特工的控制范围
内使用这个武器执行射击行动。在射击时无需选择
有效目标，永远将这名特工作为主要目标，但只需
射击次要目标，且目标无法被掩护或遮挡（换言
之，从这名特工的位置确定爆炸，但这名特工不受
影响）。
圣迹：当这名特工在战斗中首次应当被残废时，它
不会残废且余下 1 点耐伤，且在那个行动中也不会
被残废。所有剩余的攻击骰子将被弃置（包含这名
特工在近战或反击中使用的骰子）。这名特工随后
可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺或后撤行动（但后
者不能移动超过 3"），这种行动不受这名特工之前
进行的使其不能进行冲刺或后撤的行动影响。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SANCTIFIER MIRACULIST
2 6" 4+ 7
¹Wreathed: This operative can perform the Shoot action with
this weapon while within control range of an enemy operative.
Don’t select a valid target. Instead, this operative is always the
primary target, but only shoot against secondary targets and they
cannot be in cover or obscured (in other words, determine Blast
from this operative, but this operative isn’t affected).
Miracle: The first time this operative would be incapacitated
during the battle, it’s not incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining
and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the action.
All remaining attack dice are discarded (including yours if this
operative is fighting or retaliating), then this operative can
immediately perform a free Dash or Fall Back action (for the
latter, it cannot move more than 3"), even if it’s performed an
action that prevents it from performing those actions.

前，它可以执行一个无消耗的行动（近战除外），
并且您可以为此更改其命令。在那之后将其正常移
出杀戮区。
净化者、帝国、国教教会、持圣士 25

This operative cannot perform this action while within control

cards.text:
净化者杀戮小队
原型：安全保护、搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名净化者忏悔士特工
↘ 1 名净化者智天使特工
↘ 9 名净化者特工，从以下列表进行选择：
• 烈火士
• 死亡教派刺客
• 训诫士
• 圣迹士
• 传教士，装备有以下一种选项:
○ 教廷火焰喷射器，圣火火盆
○ 教廷火焰喷射器，枪托，圣器
• 传教士，装备有以下一种选项:
○ 热熔枪，链锯刃，圣器
○ 等离子枪，链锯刃，圣火火盆
• 控诉士
• 布道士
• 持圣士
• 救赎士
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:

OPERATIVES
↘ 1 SANCTIFIER CONFESSOR operative
↘ 1 SANCTIFIER CHERUB operative
↘ 9 SANCTIFIER operatives selected from the
following list:
• CONFLAGRATOR
• DEATH CULT ASSASSIN
• DRILL ABBOT
• MIRACULIST
• MISSIONARY with one of the
following options:

○ Ministorum flamer; gun butt; holy relic
• MISSIONARY with one of the
following options:

○ Plasma gun; chainsword; brazier of
holy fire

• PREACHER
• RELIQUANT

cards.text:
除了布道士特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被
纳入您的杀戮小队一次。同时。您的杀戮小队至
多能纳入四名布道士特工。
在每场战斗中，您无法选择超过一名在选项中
拥有圣火火盆的特工。
cards.text_en:
Other than PREACHER operatives, your kill
team can only include each operative on this list
once. Your kill team can only include up to four
PREACHER operatives.
You cannot select an option that includes a
brazier of holy fire more than once per battle.

cards.text:
净化者
阵营规则
烈焰
只有圣火才能消解越轨行为。通过火焰喷射
器以及燃烧的双手，信徒们清除着异端的邪
恶污秽。
这个杀戮小队中的一些武器拥有烈焰规则，其规
则如下：
*烈焰：若您的任何关键成功造成伤害，则这名
特工使用这个武器攻击的目标特工获得一枚己方
烈焰指示物（如果其尚未拥有一枚这个指示物）
。每当拥有一枚己方烈焰指示物的特工被激活，
便受到 D3 点伤害。之后控制那名特工的玩家进
行下列选项之一：
• 掷一枚 D6：若掷骰结果为 3+，则移除那枚指
示物。
• 直到那名特工那次激活结束前，将其 APL 属
性减去 1 点并移除那枚指示物。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FACTION RULE
BLAZE
Only in holy fire can deviance be absolved. With flamer
and burning hands the faithful purge the malignant taint
of heresy.
Some weapons in this team’s rules have the Blaze
weapon rule below.
*Blaze: If you inflict damage with any critical
successes, the operative this weapon is being
used against gains one of your Blaze tokens (if it
doesn’t already have one). Whenever an operative
that has one of your Blaze tokens is activated,
inflict D3 damage on it. Then that operative’s
controlling player selects one of the following:
• Roll one D6: on a 3+, remove that token.
• Subtract 1 from the operative’s APL stat until
the end of that activation to remove that token.

cards.text:
净化者
阵营规则
国教布道
一位热情洋溢的大演说家正在高声进行着布
道。话语如同焰火和硫磺一般点燃了追随者的
热情，使他们抛下伤痛继续战斗。
战略计划。选择一名己方净化者特工。若一名
己方忏悔士特工没有被残废，则您必须选择它。
直到您在战斗中再一次使用这个战略计划前，那
名特工获得演说家关键词。
当一名己方净化者特工位于一名己方演说家特
工 3" （若那名演说家为忏悔士则为 6"）内时，
那名己方净化者特工便受到布道增益。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FACTION RULE
MINISTORUM SERMON
A mighty orator booms out an impassioned sermon.
The fire and brimstone words inflame the zeal of their
followers, enabling them to shrug off wounds and
remain in the fight.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one friendly
SANCTIFIER operative. If a friendly CONFESSOR
operative hasn’t been incapacitated, you must
select it. Until you use this STRATEGIC GAMBIT
again during the battle, that operative has the
ORATOR keyword.
Whenever a friendly SANCTIFIER operative is
within 3" of a friendly ORATOR operative (or 6"
if the ORATOR is a CONFESSOR), that friendly
SANCTIFIER operative is benefitting from
the SERMON.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
当一名己方净化者特工在一名己方演说家特工
3" （若那名演说家为忏悔士则为 6"）内激活时，
那名己方净化者特工在那次激活结束前受到布
道增益（这意味着它即便因为移动超出了受演说
家增益的范围也会受到增益）。
当一名己方净化者特工受到布道增益，伤害为
4 点或更多的普通或暴击伤害造成的伤害将减去
1 点。
cards.text_en:
Whenever a friendly SANCTIFIER operative
is activated within 3" of a friendly ORATOR
operative (or 6" if the ORATOR is a CONFESSOR),
that friendly SANCTIFIER operative is benefitting
from the SERMON until the end of that activation
(i.e. even if it then moves more than the distance
requirement from the ORATOR operative).
Whenever a friendly SANCTIFIER operative
is benefitting from the SERMON, Normal and
Critical Dmg of 4 or more inflicts 1 less damage
on it.

cards.text:
净化者
战略计谋
帝皇佑护
帝国信仰最为忠实的信徒相信自己会受到帝皇
佑护。在冲入战斗时，他们认为自己的信念会
保护自己。
当一名特工对受到布道增益的一名己方净化者
特工射击时，您可以重掷任意数量的某个结果的
防御骰子（例如，结果为 2）。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
STRATEGY PLOY
THE EMPEROR PROTECTS
The most dedicated adherents to the Imperial Creed
believe that the Emperor protects. They hurl themselves
into battle, confident that their faith will shield them.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
SANCTIFIER operative that’s benefitting from
the SERMON, you can re-roll any of your defence
dice results of one result (e.g. results of 2).

cards.text:
净化者
战略计谋
虔诚击打
一旦祭司道出不可饶恕的抨击，净化者便会不
知疲倦地在怒火中作战。
当受到布道增益的一名己方净化者特工处于近
战或反击中，其近战武器便获得“无休”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
STRATEGY PLOY
FERVENT BRAWL
With the intolerant diatribes of the priesthood ringing in
their ears, the Sanctifiers fight with a tireless fury.
Whenever a friendly SANCTIFIER operative
that’s benefitting from the SERMON is fighting or
retaliating, its melee weapons have the Ceaseless
weapon rule.

cards.text:
净化者
战略计谋
狂热控诉
异端存活的时间越长，留下的印记就越难以磨
灭。因此，必须对其迅速果断地进行清理。
每当一名己方净化者特工在执行过冲锋行动的
激活中进行近战，其近战武器获得“致命 5+”
武器规则。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
STRATEGY PLOY
ZEALOUS PERSECUTION
The longer that heresy is allowed to persist, the more
indelible the mark it leaves. It must be scoured swiftly
and without mercy.
Whenever a friendly SANCTIFIER operative is
fighting during an activation in which it performed
the Charge action, its melee weapons have the
Lethal 5+ weapon rule.

cards.text:
净化者
战略计谋
召集信徒
宣讲之声盖过了雷鸣般的战斗声响，将虔诚之
人拉回队伍。
受到布道增益的每一名己方净化者特工（演说
家除外）可以立即按照您决定的顺序执行一次无
消耗的冲刺或后撤行动（为每一名特工分别进行
选择，后者不能移动超过 3")。这些行动在移动
结束时必须更为靠近一名己方演说家特工且对其
可见（反之亦然）。您不能在第一个转折点中使
用这个战略计谋。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
STRATEGY PLOY
RALLY THE FLOCK
An orator’s voice booms above the thunderous din of
combat, drawing the faithful back into formation.
Each friendly SANCTIFIER operative (excluding
ORATOR) that’s benefitting from the SERMON
can immediately perform a free Dash or Fall
Back action in an order of your choice (choose
separately for each and, for the latter, it cannot
move more than 3"). Each that does so must end
that move closer and visible to (or vice versa) a
friendly ORATOR operative. You cannot use this
ploy during the first turning point.

cards.text:
净化者
交战计谋
玫瑰念珠
作为官员神圣象征的玫瑰念珠中包含了一个转
换立场发生器，能够偏转攻击。
当一枚攻击骰子对一名己方净化者特工造成普
通伤害时使用此交战计谋。无视那次伤害。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ROSARIUS
A sacred symbol of office, the Rosarius contains a
powerful conversion field generator capable of turning
aside incoming blows.
Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice
inflicts Normal Dmg on a friendly SANCTIFIER
operative. Ignore that inflicted damage.

cards.text:
净化者
交战计谋
狂热根除
对那些与帝国信仰抗衡的人而言，只有一种刑
罚：死刑。
在一名己方净化者特工进行攻击掷骰后使用此
交战计谋。如果它射击或近战的目标为位于一
名己方演说家特工 3" （如果演说家为忏悔士则
为 6"）内的一名敌方特工，则您可以重掷任意攻
击掷骰。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ARDENT ERADICATION
For those who stand against the Imperial faith there is
only one punishment: death.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack
dice for a friendly SANCTIFIER operative, if it’s
shooting against or fighting against an enemy
operative that’s within 3" of a friendly ORATOR
operative (or 6" if the ORATOR is a CONFESSOR).
You can re-roll any of your attack dice.

cards.text:
净化者
交战计谋
烈火救赎
比起在烈火中殉难，少有其他更受到祝福的死
法了。而这种牺牲也会令伴其左右的净化者心
中隐隐燃起决心。
当拥有“烈焰”武器规则的一名己方净化者特
工被残废时，在将其移出杀戮区前使用此交战
计谋。每个位于其 2" 内且对其可见的敌方特工
获得一枚己方烈焰指示物（如果其尚未拥有一
枚)。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
REDEEMED THROUGH FIRE
There are few more blessed deaths than fiery
martyrdom. Such a sacrifice stokes smouldering resolve
in the hearts of fellow Sanctifiers.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
SANCTIFIER operative that has a weapon with
the Blaze weapon rule is incapacitated, before it’s
removed from the killzone. Each enemy operative
visible to and within 2" of it gains one of your
Blaze tokens (if it doesn’t already have one).

cards.text:
净化者
交战计谋
献身！绝不动摇
那些低阶的净化者为了上级以及确保胜利，会
非常乐意冲进刀山火海。
在一名净化者演说家特工或一名净化者圣迹士
特工被选择进行近战或成为射击行动目标时使用
此交战计谋。选择位于第一个成为有效目标或选
择执行近战的己方特工 3" 内且对其可见的另一
名己方净化者特工（忏悔士，圣迹士或演说家
除外）作为这次执行近战或成为射击行动的替代
目标（即便通常情况它无法作为可用目标）。如
果这是一次近战行动，则将那个另一名特工视为
在那次行动中处于近战特工的控制范围内。
如果那次行动为射击行动且对应远程武器拥有
“爆炸”或“洪流”武器规则，则本计谋没有
效果。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
UNWAVERING DEVOTION
Low ranking Sanctifiers will gladly hurl themselves into
the path of bullet or blade if doing so will preserve their
blessed superiors and ensure victory.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
SANCTIFIER ORATOR or SANCTIFIER
MIRACULIST operative is selected as the valid
target of a Shoot action or to fight against
during the Fight action. Select one other friendly
SANCTIFIER operative (excluding CONFESSOR,
MIRACULIST and ORATOR) visible to and within
3" of that first friendly operative to become
the valid target or to be fought against (as
appropriate) instead (even if it wouldn’t normally
be valid for this). If it’s the Fight action, treat
that other operative as being within the fighting
operative’s control range for the duration of
that action. If it’s the Shoot action, that other
operative is only in cover or obscured if the
original target was.
This ploy has no effect if it’s the Shoot action
and the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent
weapon rule.

cards.text:
净化者
阵营装备
圣珠
这种球形装置中包含着易燃油料。它会在撞击
目标时破碎，然后爆炸，将敌人包裹在燃烧的
液体中。
每个转折点限一次，一名己方净化者特工（智
天使，死亡教派刺客和圣迹士除外）可以执行下
列独特行动：
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SANCTIFICATION ORBS
These spherical devices contain flammable oils. They
shatter, ignite and detonate upon impact with their
target, coating the foe in burning liquid.
Once per turning point, one friendly SANCTIFIER
operative (excluding CHERUB, DEATH CULT
ASSASSIN and MIRACULIST) can perform the
following unique action:
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
圣珠 1AP
选择位于这名特工 6" 内且可见的一名敌方
特工。那名特工和位于其 1" 内的每一名敌
方特工都需要进行浸湿测试。每个进行浸
湿测试的特工需要掷一枚 D6 ：若掷骰结果
为 3+，则它会获得一个浸湿指示物。
当一名己方净化者特工使用拥有“烈焰”
武器规则的武器对拥有一枚己方浸湿指示
物的敌方单位进行射击时，那个武器还会
拥有“追踪”武器规则。
在一名己方净化者特工使用拥有“烈焰”
武器规则的武器对拥有一枚己方浸湿指示
物的敌方单位进行射击后，移除那枚指示
物（即便其没有使用“追踪”武器规则）。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行
此行动。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFICATION ORB 1AP
Select one enemy operative visible to and
within 6" of this operative. That operative
and each other enemy operative within 1"
of it takes a doused test. For an operative to
take a doused test, roll one D6: on a 3+, it
gains one of your Doused tokens.
Whenever a friendly SANCTIFIER operative
is shooting an operative that has one of your
Doused tokens with a weapon that has the
Blaze weapon rule, that weapon also has the
Seek weapon rule.
After a friendly SANCTIFIER operative uses
a weapon that has the Blaze weapon rule
against an enemy operative that has one
of your Doused tokens, remove that token
(even if the Seek weapon rule wasn’t used).
This operative cannot perform this
action while within control range of an
enemy operative.

cards.text:
净化者
阵营装备
贞洁印章
这些刻有神圣祷文和祝福的羊皮纸通过腊封贴
于衣物，护甲和战斗装备上。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方净化者特工进
行射击或近战时，若您的掷骰中出现两个或更多
失败，您可以弃置其中一枚，并将另一枚替换为
普通成功并保留。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PURITY SEALS
Affixed to clothing, armour and wargear by way of wax
seals, these pieces of parchment are inscribed with holy
prayers and blessings.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
SANCTIFIER operative is shooting or fighting,
if you roll two or more fails, you can discard
one of them to retain another as a normal
success instead.

cards.text:
净化者
阵营装备
国教经文
国教教会的演说家们会携带许多写在破败羊皮
纸上的激烈祷文和严厉圣诗，用于激励盟友并
羞辱敌人。
在每个战略阶段的就绪步骤中，掷 3D6 ：若掷
骰结果低于己方演说家特工剩余的耐伤，则您获
得 1 点 CP。请注意，本规则是在计谋步骤前完
成的，所以如果没有可用的演说家特工，您便无
法在那个转折点使用本规则（例如第一个转折点
中）。
cards.text_en:
SANCTIFIER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ECCLESIARCHY TEXTS
The orators of the Adeptus Ministorum carry with them
many a fiery prayer and excoriating psalm scribed on
tattered vellum, designed to inspire their allies and
diminish the foe.
In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, roll
3D6: if the result is less than the remaining
wounds of a friendly ORATOR operative, you gain
1CP. Note that this is done before the Gambit
step, so if there isn’t a valid ORATOR operative,
you cannot use this rule during that turning point
(e.g. during the first turning point).

cards.text:
净化者
阵营装备
帝国国教标志
无论是石刻还是纯金打造，这种备受祝福的宗
教符号都能赋予持有者好运。
每个转折点限一次，当一名特工对受到布道增益
的一名己方净化者特工进行射击时，在您拿取

者保留的一枚暴击成功改为一枚普通成功（任何
